'''Nix Card's office''' was located in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. It contained a couch, several chairs of the same design, Nix Card's desk, and the Muun's chair. It had windows in its back, offering views of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The room was filled with [[Color/Legends|red]] and black patterns, matching Nix Card's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="Cards on Both Sides" />
